entities.summary: Luis Videgaray Caso is a Mexican politician who served as the Secretary of Foreign Affairs from 2017 to 2018 during the presidency of Enrique Peña Nieto. Previously he was the Secretary of Finance and Public Credit, also in Peña Nieto's cabinet, from 2012 to 2016. Prior to Peña Nieto's victory in the elections, Videgaray was General Coordinator of his campaign for the 2012 presidential election. On 11 July 2012, Peña Nieto announced Videgaray as the person in charge of promoting the economic reforms and the government agenda's related topics, and on 4 September, he named Videgaray as co-head of the team that set policy direction for the new government that took office on 1 December 2012.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Luis Videgaray Caso played a key role in Enrique Peña Nieto's cabinet, serving as Secretary of Finance and Public Credit from 2012 to 2016. His appointment as co-head of the policy direction team for the new government had significant implications for Mexico's economic agenda.
